name: Nimboya's Pike
summary: Nimboya’s Pike is a weapon Nimboya lends for a grim message to the Witherbark trolls of the Hinterlands. Their betrayal of Thrall has brought the Horde’s anger to their villages.

sections.title: A Grim Message
sections.body: In Stranglethorn, Nimboya gives you his pike and sends you north to the Hinterlands. The Witherbark trolls once stood with the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall. Nimboya means for them to see that betrayal answered. He names Hiri’watha and Zun’watha as places where his message may be left.

faq.answer: Nimboya lends the pike so you can carry his message to the Witherbark trolls in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Nimboya want to punish the Witherbarks?
faq.answer: The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall.

faq.q: Where should I take the pike?
faq.answer: Nimboya sends you to the Hinterlands, northeast of Tarren Mill, to leave the message at Hiri’watha or Zun’watha.
It is Nimboya’s Pike bearing Witherbark skulls, meant to be placed in one of their villages as a grim message.

angles.text: The pike carries the Horde’s anger toward the Witherbarks for betraying Thrall, once their ally.
